name: Yuzawa (Niigata, Japan)
description: A brown field charged at the centre with the Yuzawa town emblem in white: a stylised angular character with a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Yuzawa, a town in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 6 December 1965.

features.role: Yuzawa town emblem — a stylised angular character with a ring
